## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run stylelint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] `npm run l10n` passes and `l10n/` is committed; new texts have German translations (informal and formal)
- [ ] `composer cs:check`, `composer psalm` and `composer test:unit` pass
- [ ] New routes check the role on the server and are covered by `ControllerSecurityTest`
- [ ] Keyboard and screen reader use work, information is not shown by colour alone
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and the documentation in `docs/` are updated where users notice the change
- [ ] Screenshots, examples and tests use the demo data or invented data only, no data of a real choir
